long_biography.plain_text:
An unsuccessful first venture preceded Frédéric Jousset's defining business achievement. He and Olivier Duha launched Webhelp in 2000, developing it from online assistance into a global customer-experience and outsourcing group. Concentrix completed its acquisition in 2023, closing the chapter that principally created Jousset's wealth.

He has since applied capital and operating discipline to cultural access. Art Explora uses mobile, digital and community programmes to connect new audiences with art, while ArtNova invests in cultural and creative businesses. His chairmanship of Beaux Arts & Cie adds publishing to that ecosystem, giving his second act both a public-benefit arm and a commercial investment platform.
